Condominium in Kamala
HomeNew ProjectsCoralina Kamala

Project overview

"The Hidden Gem": eight seven-storey residential buildings plus a facilities building on about 18,100 sqm in Kamala, with modern-soft architecture and a tropical garden.

564 units plus 5 shops. Kamala Beach is about 300 m away.
